summary: The portfolio spans fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners and tens of thousands of lines. [O1] holds 54% of lines; blank lines alone account for 21%, with punctuation-only lines also prominent.

Ownership crosses repository boundaries: lines written elsewhere account for 80% in [R1], 78% in [R2] and 66% in [R3]. Methods agree in no repositories, and ownership entropy ranges from 2.8 bits by line hash to 4.9 bits by commits.
At [T0], the principal owner holds 54.1%, up from 51.2% at [T-3], while inactive-owner share has eased to 76.1% from 77.9%. The next blank-line milestone is projected for [T+22].

okr.objective: Improve ownership sustainability and consistency across the codebase.

keyResults.text: Reduce principal-owner concentration from 54.1% at [T0], after rising from 51.2% at [T-3].
Continue reducing inactive-owner share from 76.1% at [T0], down from 77.9% at [T-3].
Establish agreement among ownership methods, starting from no repositories where methods agree.
